The configuration respects user environment variables and uses conditional logic appropriately (e.g., checking `has('gui_running')` before mapping GUI-specific keybindings). No obfuscation or unusual encoding is present. The file serves its documented purpose: providing sane, secure defaults without overstepping into application logic or system modification.
